reviewNotes: Reviewed all 11 cards and 44 distinct speech keys against data/pages79.json vocabulary/furigana. Questions and complete explanations use 1.0; individual anatomy vocabulary and short vocabulary-choice groups use 0.85. Display labels and distinct lookup keys unchanged. No listening or audible pitch-accent verification performed.
